question:
Let $X,Y,Z$ be the angles of a triangle.

(i) Prove that
\[
\tan\frac X2\tan\frac Y2+\tan\frac X2\tan\frac Z2+\tan\frac Z2\tan\frac Y2=1.
\]

(ii) Using (i) or otherwise prove that
\[
\tan\frac X2\tan\frac Y2\tan\frac Z2\le\frac1{3\sqrt3}.
\]

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
